LanguageData.NHTCD_Header: Races with a custom doll: {0}. Unset rows fall back to gender, then body type, then any doll.
LanguageData.NHTCD_ShowHairInXray: Show hair in the Bones / Organs view
LanguageData.NHTCD_NoDolls: No race dolls found. Drop the exported HumanlikeDoll XML into Defs/.
LanguageData.NHTCD_Debug: Debug logging (startup info, per-pawn diagnostics, missing textures)
LanguageData.NHTCD_DefaultHint: Default: every slot uses the doll from that race's patch (auto). Only slots you change manually use your pick.
LanguageData.NHTCD_DrawAllHairLayers: Draw all hair layers (off by default: only one main hairstyle, avoids overlapping hair)
LanguageData.NHTCD_DesatColors: Part colors (when off, parts flagged in the editor are drawn in grayscale)
LanguageData.NHTCD_DesatNoParts: No flagged parts yet: tick "controlled by part color switch" on a part in the editor.
LanguageData.NHTCD_TintVanillaHair: Tint vanilla hairstyles with hair color
LanguageData.NHTCD_TintVanillaHint: Draws a colored hair layer over the doll. Parts marked "linked top" are redrawn after the hair so it does not cover ears or decorations; as a trade-off those parts (and the hair) no longer show injury/scar layers.
LanguageData.NHTCD_VanillaCoords: Use custom coordinates for vanilla hairstyles (off = keep NHT default)
LanguageData.NHTCD_HarHairTint: Show HAR hair color (off = keep texture colors)
LanguageData.NHTCD_HarHairCoords: Use in-game coordinates for HAR hair
LanguageData.NHTCD_AutoFixHair: Auto-correct misplaced hair (cached after first check)
LanguageData.NHTCD_WarnNonHar: With tinting on, injured head decorations/ears no longer show wound layers.
LanguageData.NHTCD_WarnSync1: Enabling race sync also syncs: scale/offsets,
LanguageData.NHTCD_WarnSync2: custom coordinates and color display; reset also resets the whole race.
LanguageData.NHTCD_WarnMore: More options: Settings → NHT Custom Dolls.
